payload.label: Drives on my computers
payload.job: List the drives connected to this person's computer: each drive's name, where it is mounted, its size and free space, its kind (USB, disk image, internal) and whether it can be ejected
payload.description: Runs on the person's computer with the drives they granted it to see. Returns devices: each with name, mount, size_bytes, free_bytes, kind, internal, ejectable and state.

payload.label: Look inside a folder on a drive
payload.job: List the files and folders in one folder on a drive connected to this person's computer, a page at a time
payload.description: Runs on the person's computer. hidden "1" includes hidden files; offset and limit page through a long folder. Returns path, name, parent, mount, entries (name, path, kind, file_kind, bytes, modified_at), total and has_more.

path.description: A full path on a connected drive, like /Volumes/Drive/DCIM

verify.requires: a computer with a drive attached, either mounted under /Volumes with /usr/sbin/diskutil (the finder-volumes reader) or mounted inside a mount root of /proc/self/mountinfo (the mount-table reader, read-data/drives.json); both call their programs by absolute path, so no stand-in program or granted folder can supply one; the folder listing exits 1 for any path not on a connected drive

payload.label: What is using a drive
payload.job: Name the programs on this person's computer that are using one drive right now, which would stop it from ejecting
payload.description: Runs on the person's computer. Returns mount and processes (each pid and name): the programs with files open on that drive.

mount.description: Where the drive is mounted on the computer, as tool:list-connected-drives lists it, like /Volumes/Drive

verify.requires: a computer with a drive attached, either mounted under /Volumes with /usr/sbin/diskutil (the finder-volumes reader) or mounted inside a mount root of /proc/self/mountinfo (the mount-table reader, read-data/drives.json); both call their programs by absolute path, so no stand-in program or granted folder can supply one; exits 1 when the mount is not a connected drive

payload.label: What is on a drive
payload.job: Tell what is on one drive connected to this person's computer by kind of file (videos, pictures, sound, documents), with how many of each and how much space they take
payload.description: Runs on the person's computer. Reads the drive once, inside one run's time; a drive with more files than that is answered as far as it was read (complete false). Returns mount, files, bytes, complete, kinds (kind, label, files, bytes) and largest (path, bytes).

mount.description: Where the drive is mounted on the computer, as tool:list-connected-drives lists it, like /Volumes/Drive

verify.requires: a computer with a drive attached, either mounted under /Volumes with /usr/sbin/diskutil (the finder-volumes reader) or mounted inside a mount root of /proc/self/mountinfo (the mount-table reader, read-data/drives.json); both call their programs by absolute path, so no stand-in program or granted folder can supply one; exits 1 when the mount is not a connected drive

payload.label: A drive's icon
payload.job: Get the icon Finder shows for one drive connected to this person's computer, as a PNG picture
payload.description: Runs on the person's computer. size is the square size in pixels, 32 to 512 (256 when left out). Returns mount, media_type image/png and base64.

mount.description: Where the drive is mounted on the computer, as tool:list-connected-drives lists it, like /Volumes/Drive

verify.requires: macOS with a drive attached and mounted under /Volumes, and /usr/bin/osascript drawing the Finder icon (called by absolute path, so no stand-in program can supply it); exits 1 when the mount is not a connected drive

payload.label: Read a camera card's index as recording sessions
payload.job: Read a camera card's own index (its clip sidecars) on a connected drive, read only, and group the clips into recording sessions, one seed each
payload.description: Runs on the person's computer and reads only: nothing on the card is written, copied, moved or deleted. path is the card's mount, like /Volumes/1TB SSD. Returns volume (name, mount, identity), index_folder, since, session_gap_seconds, clips_in_range, clips_before_since, sidecars_unreadable, sidecars_without_media, and sessions: each {id, words "pending", came_from {source, volume, paths, at}, media {clips with start, end and seconds, session}, at}. A volume with no camera index returns no sessions.

path.description: The card's mount on a connected drive, like /Volumes/1TB SSD

verify.requires: a computer with a camera card mounted under /Volumes (its M4ROOT/CLIP folder holds the camera's clip sidecars), reached through the drives reader's checks as tool:list-a-drive-folder
